In the Shadows of the Sparrow

units.name: A Pirate Looks at Four Teas
In the Shadows of the Sparrow

description: Mushrooms soar to unnatural heights on either side of the rocky trail, an ethereal blue luminescence emanating from the gills of their colossal caps.  In unison, the glowing lamellae slowly pulse, occasionally blanketing the area in a darkness that heightens the treacherous nature of the terrain.  Oversized white lichen fans, cast with deep shadows, cling to the fungal stalks.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32040.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Narrow and meandering, a stream slips through the profusely floriated landscape, its surface obscured by a faintly glowing haze.  Tangled flowering ivy clings to a deteriorating bridge arched over the water, burrowing deep into the cracks of the worn stone.  Strangled by errant vines, verdigris lanterns adorn the crumbling end posts, lightless and long forgotten by time.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32041.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Massive dandelion puffs float against the twilit sky, swaying in a persistent breeze atop long stalks stemming from rosettes of lobed, lanceolate leaves.  Sent aloft by sporadic gusts, fuzzy seeds whip through the air until the wind settles, allowing them to drift to the earth.  Radiant orbs hover among the tufts as they fall like whiskery snowflakes, bathing the fluff-blanketed ground in honey-hued light.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32042.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Twisting through the floral forest, the trail picks a path around the enormous, conical blooms blossoming in every direction.  Rainbow ombre petals mirror the colors of the aurora-streaked sky, layered to form the giant inflorescences.  Whiskered with drooping tendrils, soaring black bat flowers interrupt the pastel hues like stygian ink splattered on a watercolor painting.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32043.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Evocative of wispy parasols, towering flowers shelter the narrow trail, globules of dew gracing their cerulean-limned, emerald ray florets.  Overgrown lilies thrive in the dappled shade, their sprawling, jewel-toned blooms bespeckling the landscape with saturated coloration.  Adding hints of vibrant foliage, heart-shaped wild ginger peeks out from around the blossoms.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32044.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Virid vegetation covers the rolling earth, ripe with fanning ferns and leafy laurels.  Unusually immense, green ball dianthus speckle the abundant verdure with shaggy, lime-hued domes.  The lush greenery is shot with sprigs of chartreuse orchids, their labella blushed a rich cerise shade.  Emitting a pale inner glow, tiny spheres dart through gaps in the flora.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32045.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Colossal jet black rocks, sharp-cornered and irregular, protrude at varying angles from a sanguine sea of poppies.  Shallowly incised runes cover the entirety of the formations, the symbols too worn to be decipherable.  Nigh intoxicating, a heady floral aroma pervades the air, caught between the arboreal silhouettes bordering the eastern and western edges of the efflorescent field.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32046.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Auroral lights paint the twilight-kissed sky, a vibrant backdrop for the beheaded obsidian obelisk standing sentinel over a tranquil pond ringed in horsetail reeds.  Visible beneath the surface, the severed point glistens in the soft illumination emanating from multitudes of floating, ghostly white lotuses.  Polychromatic orbs spin in a whirling dance above the crystal clear water.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32047.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gossamer webs, strung with shimmering dew beads, stretch between the luminous stalks of lofty, flat-capped mushrooms that look as though they were carved from jade.  Growing in irregular, petal-like clusters, apricot jelly fungi patch the damp soil with their illumed, gelatinous forms.  Foliose lichen encrusts the rocks that force the path to pick a winding way through the area.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32048.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Narrow and straight, the trail cuts through the center of a monumental fairy ring created by fly agaric.  Pleated parasol mushrooms spread across the clearing like blanched grass, dwarfed by the sky-high circle and surrounding forest.  The fungal field luminesces in rippling waves, the rhythmic ebb and flow reminiscent of moonlit waves rolling through a vast ocean.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32049.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Basket fungus branches into massive round and oval balls, giant sculptures handcrafted by nature.  Tinting the bone white frames with delicate hues, pastel orbs of light weave in and out of the geometrical latticework.  Whisper-thin mycelium threads split into countless forks as they spread across the moisture-laden path, redolent of pulled cotton.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32050.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bulging, magenta pustules dot the rounded purple caps of tree-sized toadstools draped with sickly green, tentacular vines.  Their cores have a faint, deep amber glow, adding to the garishness of the multicolored scenery.  Large enough to devour a halfling, carnivorous plants stand with their cilia-fringed mouths agape, waiting to snap shut around unsuspecting prey.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32051.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rampant briars crisscross in arcs over the shrinking creek as it winds to the south, blocking the trail in that direction and suffocating the other plant life.  The lifeless remains of snapdragons sprout between the thorns in a failed attempt to escape their tangled prisons.  Dried conical inflorescences adorn the long stems, the clustered flowers redolent of miniature, dead-eyed skulls.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32052.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bright purple hues from the auroral twilight sky lend a diffuse luminosity to the dense mists hanging in the air.  Cushioned with an overgrown mass of vivid yellow and magenta flowers, a crescentic islet cuts through the curving stream, splitting it in two.  The heavy haze blurs the intense colors of the flourishing blossoms and viridescent foliage to a painterly effect.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32053.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wildflowers grow in abundance, blossoming to the water's edge in shocks of intense pink and fuchsia contrasted against dark greenery.  Straggly saplings frame the fog-hazed scene, their leaf-bare branches caught with petite white blooms.  Agitation clouding its churning surface, the brook tumbles over the rapids, jutting rocks and sodden deadfall diverting its course.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32054.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sprouted with crimson-capped toadstools and blanketed in verdant mosses, a fallen tree bridges the breadth of the creek, powdery decay spilling onto the path from one jagged end.  A low mist hangs above the steadily flowing water and creeps over the root-threaded banks.  Slowly, it twines around the scattered, multicolored inflorescences flourishing within the adjacent verdure.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32055.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dense curls of fog unfurl over the stream, suffused with a pale, prismatic glow reflected from the light limning the rippled water.  Alongside the banks, hundreds of golden eyes stare blankly up from the slender, pointed petals of dwarf crested irises.  Translucent sage green leaves branch from glittering wood moss, feathering the edges of the scraggly, roughly blazed trail.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32056.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Foliated tendrils drape from the tree boughs, creating a natural corridor for the hazy creek to wind through.  The leafy veils softly radiate an aqua phosphorescence that tints the muddy path and the wispy, spindly spider lilies sprouted along it.  Spangling the verdant curtains with points of white light, bright orbs drift aimlessly through the threadlike vines.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32057.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dappled with glistening beads of dew, feathery painted ferns thrive beside the streambanks.  A luminous cloak of greenery droops from the trees on either side, casting a blue-green glow over the fringe-winged white egret orchids interspersed amongst the fronds.  Lichen-encrusted roots burst from the damp trail as it follows the gentle curve of the brook.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32058.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Many-petaled falls of purple wisteria overtake the gnarled, leafless trees looming over the small, lambent pool feeding the creek.  Trickling from hollows in the trunks, rivulets cascade over moss and roots to the water's surface.  The floral-enswathed scene is set aglow by globular, celestial blue crystals caught in coiled branches, deepening the shadows of the forest beyond the veil.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32059.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Marigolds and mums encroach upon the path as it slips past explosions of forsythia, shrouding the way beneath their sunny pom-poms.  Crushed to a brownish mush, countless petals litter the dirt track, only the ghosts of cheery yellow coloration remaining.  Sunflowers shoot up from the golden field, their round visages tilted downward under the weight of plump seeds.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32060.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As orange as a burning sunset, zinnias and dahlias overtake the unrestrained gardens, popping into oversized globes of vivid petals.  Radiant light condenses into the forms of ethereal butterflies, resplendent and multihued, that flutter over the elaborate, inflorescent orbs.  Luminous motes trail off the tips of their intangible, wispy wings as they flit from bloom to bloom.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32061.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flames of the forest trees bow over the sloping path, appearing ablaze from the clusters of brilliant scarlet flowers wrapping their sprawling limbs.  Below the fiery canopy, gnarled roots crawl out from eroded banks, fusing into contorted, natural steps caught between the crumbling faces of earth as they descend to the south.  Mosses creep across the organic stairs like a thin, verdant carpet.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32062.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hungry flytraps bide their time, spread open to reveal their cerise mouths, while others have tightly clamped jaws as they digest a recent meal.  Damp and mossy, the trail passes through a menagerie of exotic plants with creeping tendrils, curvy shapes, and glaring colors.  The occasional butterwort with its pastel hues appears deceptively innocuous in comparison to its gaudy surroundings.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32063.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Multitudinous vasiform plants, in varying shades of putrid greens and deep maroons, pack the naturally terraced earth with a miniature forest that grows more vast with each consecutive tier.  Hanging from long stems, burnt orange pitcher plants dangle over the edges, their curled lips dripping with tacky liquid.  Radiant pink spheres, darker at the core, aimlessly float through the jungle-like terrain.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32064.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sanguine mosses, sodden and squishy, cushion the alien landscape in a lurid display of color.  Shaped like gargantuan disks, chartreuse sundews tilt at diverse angles and decorate the terrain in a random, spotty pattern.  Dense roseate hairs sprout from the flat surfaces, tipped with viscous globules of mucilage.  The sticky orbs slowly consume hapless insects hopelessly trapped within.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32065.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Skirted by a blood red spathe, a single titan arum with a cylindrical inflorescence dominates the flora with its massive presence and overwhelming malodor of rotting corpses.  The surrounding crimson-blushed plant life tilts away from the fetid flower, the tubular lime green pitchers shrinking back in curved curls to leave a clear circle around the tapered base.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32066.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stellate blooms match the tint of the cerulean haze enveloping their aculeate, royal blue stems, which branch into fuzzy curls tipped with burgeoning buds.  Curving around exposed chunks of slate, the trail travels past the prickly plants.  Love-in-a-mist grows rampantly in a cloud of fractal foliage, their cobalt blooms centered with tentacle-like stamen clusters.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32067.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dainty vines laden with cream-throated lapis blossoms twist down slender tree trunks and tumble over the ground, tangling hazardously over the path as it meanders through the unbridled garden.  Casting a somber illumination over the tall flower spikes, deep blue-violet orbs drift through the profusion of wild indigo flourishing within their verdant leaves.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32068.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Aswirl with blooms tinted dusky violet in the muted lighting of twilight, flowering jacaranda trees spread their contorted limbs over the petal-strewn path.  Royal purple plants provide intensely colored, shimmery foliage traced with viridescent veins and rachis.  Stalks of larkspur pepper the vegetation, their blossoms opened in bold displays of rich plum hues.
title: [Bittermere Woods Gardens]
32069.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spindly branches of blackened wood extend across the sanguine-splattered ground, casting macabre shadows over the small abandoned dwellings within the neighborhood proper.  A single tapered branch pierces through a nearby window, the wood covered in wispy cobwebs extending in a fan-like shape.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Entry]
31981.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tall dented brass lantern casts warped images across the crumbling cottages scattered along the hillside, the green-black flame sputtering and hissing as wax bleeds down the pole to pool above the dirt.  Vibrant fireflies blink in and out of viewing as they dart through the broken window panes, exposing a large silhouette looming closer as the insects grow in number.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31982.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Twin rows of skeletal trees line each side of the crossroads, their gnarled branches perched with dozens of crows, each one gazing down at the sigil-covered ground.  The faint cry high above reveals a duo of vultures, the predators circling lower with each flap of their wings above a circle of empty buildings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Endeltime Estates, The Crossing]
31983.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wrinkled vines of blackened foliage snake through the fence encircling a group of empty homes, consuming the spaces as they cling to the crumbling walls.  The vein-like appendages creep up through the holes in the thatch roofing, grasping upwards into the empty air, the vines casting undulating shadows into the dwellings below.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31984.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A quartet of veined marble pedestals hold dented bronze statues, each facing a cardinal direction, their faces gouged through in deep furrows from temple to throat.  The dirt beneath each column rises above the edges, the uneven earth tilting each one forward in a slow descent towards a row of empty homes.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Endeltime Estates, The Midian]
31985.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Twin rows of overgrown topiaries frame the roadway before each dwelling, the former knight-shaped bodies left in a disarray of creepers and decaying foliage.  Each topiary grasps at an iron-tipped spear, the tips snapped off cleanly and scattered amongst the debris gathered beneath the sculptures.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31986.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A rusted iron gate dominates the open, dirt-packed road, its bars bent and broken beneath the wrought metal raven adorning the top, its gilt-pronged eye sockets gouged by heavy vines piercing through the available space.  The crumbling facades surrounding the gate cast ominous shadows through the broken windows, each one marked by a faded blood red sigil.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Endeltime Estates, The Passing]
31987.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tall hedges form a small maze beyond the house-lined roadway, the untended briars closing in the entry in a thick wall of thorns.  A shattered circle of pale grey benches sits before the maze, the stones covered in rust-colored stains, the markings following the cobblestone trail towards the main path.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31988.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Trellises of pale wood lay buried in the crumbling stone of several abandoned cottages, the latticed pieces snapped in half, leaving the dried flora to spill across the muck.  Smashed garden ornaments litter the ground before the road, the shards of glass embedded in the black-colored mud.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31989.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crumbling marble arches encircle the quartet of pathways, the carved columns consumed by ichor-stained vines climbing along the lengths of stylized fauna, stretching out before several ruined structures.  Dented braziers of rusted brass flank each arch, peeled apart as though made from fragile parchment.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west
title: [Endeltime Estates, The Junction]
31990.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The mud-covered road is flanked by twin plank-affixed structures built high upon the winding hill, the small boxes left unkempt as dozens of bats swoop in and out of the torn wire enclosures.  A third house lays horizontally in the tall grasses beside a large home, the broken gaps allowing small rodents to slip and out in search of food.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31991.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A scatter of overturned tables and chairs covers the dead grass across the small rolling hill, the shattered plates and cutlery buried beneath mounds of upturned earth.  A blackened pyre stands behind a half-circle of homes, stacked high with cloth-covered shapes left to smolder between the layers of foliage.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Brass Lane]
31992.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An awning spreads from an empty chateau toward a wood-framed patio, the canvas ripped asunder, exposing the overturned chairs and cushions littered along the floor.  Several broken instruments lay against the blackened walls of the dwelling, their bodies gutted and left beside a bent music stand.
title: [Endeltime Estates, The Branch]
31993.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small yarn-haired doll lays buried in the muck along the road, its button eyes barely hanging from fragile thread.  A trail of discarded toys and various household sundries leads up to an abandoned three-story house, the facade covered in a macabre veil of blackened smoke marks.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
31994.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An enormous grey-stained web expands between two worn-down homes, the sticky tendrils clinging to the shattered window frames extending further into the residence.  Web-spun forms can be viewed through the doorways, the engulfed bodies seeping a dark rust-colored liquid into the floorboards below.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
31995.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A desolated garden has been spread out before a quintet of small cottages, the flora and fauna torn from the ground and strewn across the thatched rooftops.  Droplets of rust-colored liquid have dried within the root beds, intermingled with decayed piles of unidentified mammals.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
31996.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Untidy rows of gravestones stand before a group of empty wooden cottages, the markers shattered between the waves of asymmetric grass.  The sites lay open, the piles of dirt and bodies overturned, exposing worn down coffins pillaged of valuables.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
31997.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The gravel scattered across the ground has been stained in globules of sticky black ichor, the liquid streaked across the battered doorways of several structures along the path.  Broken planks and various debris litter the grass between the homes, the wood branded with undecipherable runes.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
31998.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Decaying garlands of ichor-covered flora drape from each of the four houses sitting at the foot of the hill, the strands dangling at intermittent lengths before drooping into the puddles of brackish water filling the holes dipping in the dry grass.  Flashes of fur dart between the homes, skittering off into the shadowed recesses through the open doors.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
31999.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A scorched sign creakily hangs from a lampost before a two-story dwelling, the walls of the empty home smashed into rubble that litters the street below.  A wending path of overgrown hedges frames the entrance, the sound of rustling emanating between the leaves.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Jejune End]
32000.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large villa stands at the top of the hill, the cobblestones leading towards the structure splattered in bits of flesh and ichor.  The shattered glass windows spill out billowing curtains riddled in moth-consumed holes, the fabric weeping down the blackened walls.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Dread End]
32001.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A heavily branched copse of witchwood trees hover above a duo of ruined stone buildings, their spindly limbs dripping a noxious black liquid onto the cobblestones below.  Occasional flashes of bright yellow eyes appear between the broken window panes, swiftly disappearing back into the darkness.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Joydrop End]
32002.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An algae-curtained pond curves around a tall, pewter-spired dwelling, the brackish water dotted by the carcasses of former inhabitants floating in the wake.  The corvid-topped spire lays at a sharp angle, scraping against the hole-hidden rooftop loosened from the framework.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32003.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sparks of lit ash float from within a circle of dwellings, the motes stark against the charred walls and smoldering rooftops.  The front doors lay broken across the blackened dirt, covered in deep scratch marks from corner to corner.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32004.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gnarled ebonwood tree lays slanted against a stone-forged cottage, its bark emitting an orange-red glow from within the trunk, the branches warping with the heat of the fire.  The occasional sound of crumbling rock echoes from within the home, followed by the crackle of consuming flame.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32005.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Some crumbled sculptures lie ruined before a pair of chateaus, their marble arms reaching out from beneath the piles of stone, palms facing up at the sky.  Rivulets of dark liquid spill forth from the shattered windows, staining the grass in circles of black.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32006.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small house sits at the bottom of the curved hill, the walls covered in thick layers of blackened webs, the surface decorated by desiccated insects and bits of bone.  Broken windows reveal eggs stuck to the inner frame of the home, covering the tiny enclosure from floor to ceiling.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32007.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A faint greenish black glow emanates from the stained glass windows of a nearby residence, the shattered glass forming teeth-like protrusions across the home's log-stacked walls.  The wheels of an upturned wagon lay by the roadway, the various parts of the vehicle scattered across the area.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32008.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Oddly bent poles of blackened iron hang limp silk pennants, the frayed fabric wrapped around the metal supports by thin stands of webbing.  The crooked display stands before a long stone villa, the pristine exterior a stark contrast to the scorched interior viewable from the outside.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Hakney Downs]
32009.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A broken latticed pathway leads towards a slate-colored villa, the high walls choked by dead ivy vines creating a webwork across the sigil-stained doors.  Rows of decapitated rose bushes flank either side of the structure, the petals staining the cobblestones in faded red streaks.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Tilly Ending]
32010.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A desolate house of wood and stone has been broken in half, exposing the blackened trail of destruction from the pathway to the treehouse built behind the structure.  Deep grooves across the ground are filled with mud and carrion, the troughs tempting a group of vultures observing from a nearby tree.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Filly Ending]
32011.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A two-storied home sits upon the desolated hill, the blackened silhouettes of flames encompassing the stone walls.  The faint glinting of broken glass litters the dried grass beneath the house, the metal window frames warped into contorted curls of melted iron, the claw-like bars extending into the dwelling.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
32012.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A quartet of thatch-roofed dwellings litter the small blackened hillside, the cobbled pathway traced by a dry streambed, the shallow sands exposing the gnarled roots of a nearby witchwood tree.  Sickly grey vines snake across the banks of the stream, splaying across the grasses like thin veins of ash.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
32013.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A hole-covered bridge connects a group of dwellings, the gaps between the planks revealing a dried up streambed littered with fish skeletons tangled in strips of decaying weeds.  Several runes are unevenly carved across the railings, the symbols scratched out by oversized claw marks.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
32014.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A crooked house of blackened stone leans precariously over a black algae-covered pond, the water's surface littered with scorched pieces of thatch bobbing between the dark patches of aquatic plants.  The long-tailed form of an unknown mammal stalks between the dense reeds edging the waters, causing the grasses to rustle subtly before going still.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Banal Court]
32015.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A vine-choked stone villa stands beneath the imposing silhouettes of twin trees, the bower beneath littered with small skeletons semi-buried beneath the rising weeds.  A carved marble pedestal displayed before the home is filled with a thick black liquid, the ichor spilling down onto the cobbled ground.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Stone Drive]
32016.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Long ribbons barely hang from the tall pole at the center of the house-filled area, their faded colors sprinkled with flecks of rust and splatters of dark mud.  Molding floral garlands adorn the contorted iron gate encircling the plaza, the blossoms collapsing above shallow puddles of brackish water.
title: [Endeltime Estates, Stone Drive]

description: The melody from the front room can still be faintly heard, its tune both beautiful and serene.  Several gilded birdcages are suspended above a black velvet-draped table.  An old stool occupies a far corner, with a smattering of wood chips scattered all around it.
title: [Stay Tuned, Backroom]
32176.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Acicular crystal formations pierce through the mahogany planks of the repurposed house, their facets glinting from the pulsing glow emanating from a dusty, orb-capped chandelier.  A barbed wrought iron stand casts spiked shadows softened by the gentle, rhythmic illumination.  Barely concealing a narrow staircase, devore velvet curtains patterned in monochromatic florals echo the profusion of black star calla lilies framing the glass display case set to one side.
title: [Pierced Veil, First Floor]
32177.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs lead up to a spacious room with a pair of splintered doors on the western wall.  Tattered shreds of gossamer drape from the edges of the ceiling, brokenly veiling tilted paintings and a full-length mirror tucked into one corner.  In the center of the room, open manacles hang from the armrests and footrest of a reclined leather chair.  Scattered around a mahogany console table, piles of dusty velvet cushions provide an alternative to the questionable seating.
title: [Pierced Veil, Second Floor]
32178.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Silver hoops of varying sizes, within which stretch multitonal floral doilies, hang from overhead beams by twisted hemp cord.  Scattered across warped, and somewhat rotted, floorboards are overstuffed crocheted cushions dyed a dark mulberry red and sewn with intricate beadwork along the edge.  Beside a garland-framed arch, an unsteady pillar displays a large fishbowl filled with murky green water.
title: [Buckle Up, Backroom]
32179.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Blackened stone walls slick with moisture line the area, while a precariously hung lantern casts shadows throughout.  Broken bits of furniture and decorations lay strewn like obstacles as water drips steadily in one corner of the room.  A thick onyx table stands near the back wall with a silver-handled obsidian dagger resting on it while a single post of scorched ironwood stands upright alongside it.
title: [Masqued Intentions, Basement]
32180.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground floor of the minaret is packed earth, nearly frozen solid even within the thick walls.  A dusty cushion sits half askew at the base of a stone spiral staircase, the steep curve of which disappears upwards into a distant darkness.  Someone has left a bulky ceramic jug and a few lumpy pottery cups to lie in a dusty pile.
title: [The Minaret, Ground Floor]
32182.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Only a bit of light seeps in from above and below to illuminate the sharp curve of the spiral staircase.  It wends its way upwards and downwards in the minaret, its risers and treads carved from the tower's stone itself.  There is no handrail.
title: [The Minaret, Up the Spire]
32183.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The simple, round chamber is little more than a landing, with a carved stone spiral staircase continuing both up and down.  A small bit of floor has been stolen from the center of the ring, upon which is a wooden plinth.  An arrowslit lets in a bit of starlight.
title: [The Minaret, Midspire]
32184.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tight coil of treads and risers continues.  Along the wall, a thin eburnation smoothes a second spiral to complement the larger curve, as years upon years of bracing hands have worn the rough stone to a polished finish.  A single arrowslit lets in a bit of light, enough to see the outline of well-fitted trapdoor in the ceiling just above the top of the stairs.
title: [The Minaret, Up the Spire]
32185.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In the center of the minaret, a decorative stone spire has been rudely truncated and the carved block left to sit alongside its former place.  An enormous telescope of aged brass and shining glass sits atop the makeshift dais, sturdy and steady as if it had always been there.  Around the instrument are boxes of papers and crates of ornaments.  A trapdoor, or a long fall, are the only ways off of the rooftop.
title: [The Minaret, Rooftop]
32186.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick cobwebs with a cache of moths, flies, and beetles wrapped in their silky strands stretch across a tightly spiraled staircase.  At the foot of the stairs, a curtain has been pulled partway across a darkly stained mahogany panel, its edges illuminated with warm, glowing light from behind.  A spider dangles from a wax-covered candelabra set atop a high-wrought walnut newel post.
title: [Evermore Hotel, Hidden Room]

description: The muffled sounds of passersby trickle through the heavy metal-strapped door separating the entryway from the outside.  A thick bristly rug sits on the dark slate tile just inside the door as a token attempt to corral the mud and dirt from outside, and some polished brass coat hooks line one wall.  A wide crystal-paned door to the side leads into a dark-panelled room, and opposite it is a curving stairway.  Behind the stairway, the tantalizing smell of cooking wafts down a narrow hallway.

description: Plush velvet carpeting spreads from the top of the staircase throughout this cozy sitting room.  A long settee upholstered in pale ivory silk sits near the small curtained window with a sleek ebonwood case resting on its wide sill.  A massive ebonwood bookcase built into the far wall frames a small marble fireplace, and the cheerfully crackling fire within casts a warm flickering light over the contents of a velvet-lined basket set out on a small accessory table nearby.
title: [Accessories Of Crime]

description: The formal living area just past the wide crystal-paned door is lined with dark mahogany wainscoting, and a plush velvet rug protects the polished hardwood floors.  A large bay window fitted with a wide seating bench sits catty-corner to a polished marble fireplace, and the aromatic scent of smoke wafts through a curving archway in the wall opposite it.  Framing the archway is a tall apothecary rack and a polished glass-topped case.
title: [Cut And Dried]

description: Several thick armchairs provide comfortable seating near some accent tables. A wide archway across from the windows leads back to a living area, while a pair of glass-paned doors opposite the hearth offers a glimpse of a cozy kitchen.

description: A long kitchen island topped with heavy butcher's block is flanked on one side with a row of upholstered stools, and on the other by a brick hearth wall. Faint light can be seen down a narrow hallway, and beyond the row of stools are a pair of glass-paned doors.

description: Long rows of shelves covered in various wares, weapons and equipment, line the entirety of the back wall behind a long polished granite countertop.  A large chandelier hangs from a coiled chain at the center of the room, its tongs holding glass orbs that glow with a white arcane light.
title: [Duskruin Arena, Stygian Annex]
23798.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Iron sconces line the stone walls, barely illuminating the narrow entryway. A dark beaded curtain on the northern wall leads toward the back of the structure, while two passageways fork off around the curtain.
title: [The Mar and Scar, Threshold]

description: Upon the northern wall is an old rack -- its rollers seized-up and inoperative.  Oddly shaped tools lie rusted on a small metal table near the torture device.  Several cushioned divans surround a lacquered bloodwood mirror in the center of the room.

description: Along the eastern wall of the darkened alcove, a crimson glass display case gleams faintly in the dim light.  A sanguine-hued rug spills out from beneath the case, resembling a splattered pool of blood.  Off in the corner of the room lies an iron maiden, locked open for display.

description: A bloodjewel chandelier dims the surroundings, giving enough light to see the inventory strewn everywhere. Small circular holes, some with iron thorns protruding from them, riddle the stone walls.
title: [The Mar and Scar, Pierced]
23804.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Standing in the center of the room is a large treasure chest filled with relics old and new.  A smoky haze obscures the area, with the only source of light coming from a poorly lit chandelier dangling over the chest.  A rickety wooden ladder leads above.
title: [The Mar and Scar, Concealed]
23805.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The unfinished walls of the room support a few torches giving off sufficient light to examine the shop's wares.  The smell of oiled leather mixes with their scent.  At the far end of the room, a row of hooks hang directly over a large wooden box lined with soft grey felt, and a multi-armed display stand is situated near the entrance to the shop's next area.  A small sign has been nailed to a dented and punctured wood door.
title: [Khloake and Dagger, Sheaths]
23808.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The very faint scent of mineral oil lingers in the air of the sparsely furnished, torch-lit room.  A chest of dark ironwood drawers stands near the back wall, and off to one side, a tall display case reflects the firelight.  A neatly inked card is tacked to the wall.
title: [Khloake and Dagger, Daggers]
23809.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The clean floor is comprised of octagonal clay tiles, each one painted with some type of glass or bottle.  A chandelier hangs over the counter, casting its light over the area.
title: [Under the Counter]
23810.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of this perfectly square room are painted a pale fawn hue and bisected by a strip of pristine white molding.  Decorative yet functional brass sconces hang in the center of each, casting a warm glow over a pair of mannequins that stand on either side of a tall oak cabinet.  A deep gold velvet curtain on the opposite wall leads to the store room.
title: [Under the Counter]
23811.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tall metal shelves line three out of four of the room's walls, with only the wall around the curtained exit not supporting storage.  A shop sign sits upon one of the shelves, while all around it are supplies: empty glassware, towels, and, with no apparent commonality, a stuffed honey badger.
title: [Under the Counter, Store Room]
23812.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Swathes of thick material are draped from the slanted ceiling, creating a billowing canopy.  Several mannequins line the walls of the shop, their armor and weapons gleaming in the pale light from several flickering candles.  A variety of sashes are stacked on a long counter standing center in the small room.
title: [Skyfire, Showroom]
23813.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bright carpets cushion the wooden floor, while colorful lengths of silk drape from the ceiling.  Several mannequins stand in a circle in the center of the room.  Beautiful tapestries cover the walls, their bright threads creating the symbols of the six Dai of the Erithians.
title: [Skyfire, Showroom]
23814.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of this crude hut look as if they could collapse at any moment, their half-rotted planks held together with bent nails and frayed rope.  The lone back wall displays a rusted iron plaque hanging at a slant over a row of large chests, trunks, and crates.  A single lantern hangs precariously from one of the rafters, providing a dim, flickering light.
title: [Ode To Resistance]
23815.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wedged between the two adjoining buildings, the cramped shop measures only a few spans wide, the claustrophobic aura enhanced by the thick beams supporting the ceiling.  In contrast to the drabness, light trickling in from the window set in the narrow door reveals an abrupt end to the packed dirt from outside and glints off various metallic wares displayed along the plastered walls.  A squat little stove, crackling with burning wood, serves to keep the few refreshments on top piping hot and the shop's patrons warm.
title: [Drawing The Line]
23819.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fire burns within a stone hearth, adding an aromatic haze to the area.  Several old chairs form a semicircle around the fireplace, with a small table nestled in-between, forming a quaint gathering area.  Off to the side, a velvet-lined display case's contents are evenly spaced and elevated on an incline to enhance their presentation.  A small placard has been perched on the top of the case.
title: [Smoke Screen, Back Room]
23821.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The utilitarian interior of the wagon could generously be described as spartan.  Not a single sign of inhabitation graces the area.  An engraved bow rack, a carved runestaff display, and a large weapon stand are the only furniture within the bare confines.  An oil lamp rests in the middle of the floor, illuminating its sparse surroundings.
title: [Rock Solid]
23822.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crowded with debris and irregular slabs of granite, the cramped temple entry preserves centuries of history, despite its apparent aging.  Sconces coated with a thick layer of dust emit a faint glow and line the moss-covered walls.  Ancient runic linework fills the center of the room and extends along the ground toward the south.
title: [Underground Temple, Threshold]
24546.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A steel-footed iron brazier rests in the center of the room, its hazy glow barely enough to illuminate the area.  Faceless stone idols stand shoulder-to-shoulder in a protective formation before the southerly exits.
